headline: Netflix Stock Rises After Eight-Day Losing Streak. What’s Fueling the Move.

In May, Canada’s equivalent to the Federal Communications Commission said it would require large streamers to contribute 15% of Canadian revenue to Canadian content.  The Motion Picture Association and the U.S. ambassador to Canada had pressed the country to change the policy, and the government acquiesced late Wednesday.
